Julia (CSM): Quick post-QBR note — thanks everyone for the run. Wanted to capture next steps and the clean list for exec follow-up + renewal risks from the call.

Oliver (Product): I pulled the ask list from the call. Two product asks: (1) clarify KPIs for activation flows, (2) timeline for dedicated capacity pilot.

- Oliver (Product): KPI definitions for activation (due 1719999360)
- Ben (Eng): Dedicated capacity ETA + infra blocker list (due 1719999400)
- Aisha (Growth): Cohort churn one-pager + sample cohorts (due 1719999300)
